title: Cape Point and Boulders Beach
content:
The old lighthouse at Cape Point, the sign at the Cape of Good Hope, and the African penguin colony at Boulders Beach near Simon's Town.

Demo day with no recorded route. Photographs from Wikimedia Commons, credited in each caption.
